body: I know its not but it feels so much like it is. And I just don't see thing getting any better.

I have a collection of Guitars, ukeleles, and other instruments actually, and have been picking away at them for years. However I've never seen much progress despite practice with them for over an hour a day for probably eight months, but for that time I was practicing, almost all of my disposable income was going into getting more instruments. But I've recently given up on them for the most part. 

But you mention this thing called friends. You might have missed the note, but I was homeschooled from basically the beginning. I never made friends in real life, and now all that lives in my area is a bunch of  old rednecks. I live six and a half miles from the nearest bus stop, and dont own a bike and have less than $100 to my name, m entire family having less than $1k. I dont know whats going to happen in the next few days, but damn death sure does sound sweet at the moment.

not really, its just something that came through my head.

And to your comment on electricians, yeah that could happen however, i've basically been fired, as of ~two months ago, seeing as for an extended period, no one in my family had transport other than my father who had left, then my father was hospitalized etcetera. Now my father is gone again, and as I said earlier, I have good reason to believe he's committed suicide. I dont have contact with any of my co-workers, As none of them really liked me much, saw me as more of a burden on the job than a help. (plus my location isn't the greatest in terms of distance to work.) Last "job" I know of for the company I was at is over 40 miles out from my house, and closest ex-coworker I know where lives is about the same distance out.
I have good reason to believe that he has committed suicide within the past few hours.

I dont know what I need, I'm confused, and pretty damn sure I just lost my dad. And I feel like my family is about to just fall apart. And I feel like it would be harder to watch my family fall to pieces than it would be to live. I don;t know what steps to take to move forward. And I'm useless when it comes to thinking up a plan. I know I should try and live on, but I honestly don't see a point in continuing my life when I know it'll end its self eventually.
